metadata.selection_rule: Latest hourly WINDFOR publication <= 09:00 UTC on decision day for each hourly delivery target
metadata.cutoff_note: 09:00 GMT is a deliberately conservative illustrative cutoff, not a universal GB market gate closure.
metadata.error_convention: forecast minus actual: positive error is overforecast (shortfall risk)
metadata.resolution: Hourly WINDFOR; FUELHH half-hourly WIND outturn aggregated to hourly mean MW
metadata.aggregation_rule: For each hour, average the two FUELHH 30-minute wind MW readings; require both.
